verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence of programmatic pipeline management is a documented Warehouse Sync API for setting up warehouse ingestion, which covers a narrow form of source creation. Connecting outputs is documented only as a UI flow (Setup > Directory), and no MCP server is evidenced. missing for 10: API to create general sources/inputs and destinations/outputs, API-driven wiring of streams/connections, delivery inspection or monitoring via API, an MCP server, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can manage the pipeline itself — create sources and destinations, wire streams, inspect deliveries — through a documented API or MCP server

citations.quote: with a Warehouse Sync API, SQL reference, and data mapping.
